turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hi! Please send your order number and the email you used to place the order, and let me know what you’d like to discuss about your damage claim.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the damage claim decision.

input.summary: Customer (patrick.okonkwo@example.com) disputes the closure of their existing damage claim for SC-3072. They report staff said the pale patches are part of the drawing. Please review the prior claim and respond to the customer.
